3116.translation: Carbon neutrality mean greenhouse-gas emissions equal amount wey dem absorb or remove, so net emissions become zero. E no mean stopping every emission completely. Parts wey hard to reduce fit get balanced through forests or capture technology. So carbon neutrality need both direct reduction and ways to offset remaining emissions.

3117.translation: A: Opinions differ about cutting main interest rate. Make we first hear Dr. B. B: Lower rates reduce interest burden and fit revive spending. But household debt high now, so extra money fit go repay debt instead. C: I understand, but we no fit just watch economy sink. B: I no oppose cut itself. I mean say without debt-management measures, expected effect fit reduce by half.

3118.translation: A: Opinions split over adding more alley CCTV. B: Some studies say e help prevent crime, but footage fit get used beyond purpose. So rule must clearly set installation purpose and storage time. C: I think adding surveillance wey effect never proven na the problem. B: True, evidence still no enough. But banning every installation no follow. We fit run am for fixed period, assess effect and require removal if e no work.

3119.translation: A: Some say climate-model error mean make we delay response. C: If models give different numbers, why no wait before costly policy until we sure? B: Models differ about how much temperature go rise, no be whether e go rise. Also, worst-case damage far bigger than preparation cost. C: So uncertainty alone no justify waiting? B: Waiting justified only if uncertainty shake even the direction. No be that situation now.

3120.translation: A: Should youth-support payment go everybody or only low-income youth? B: Income division fit stigmatise recipients and leave people just above cutoff without support. I favour universal payment. C: Funding na problem. To give everybody, you need cut amount well-well or raise tax. B: I no deny am. Na why I no propose full rollout immediately. Start with smaller age group, observe effect, then widen.

3121.translation: A: District office want reduce physical counters and move applications online. C: Online service reduce costs and waiting. Staff limited. B: Efficiency improve, true. But residents wey no familiar with online service fit depend on counter as only channel. Removing channel often hurt people wey already struggle to make their voices heard. C: But staff problem remain. B: So instead of removing counters, reduce low-use hours and move those staff to help desk.

3122.translation: A: Literal or free translation for classical poetry na old debate. B: I think literal translation should be base. Free version fit make translator interpretation look like original. C: But choosing word meanings one by one na interpretation already. No translation without interpretation. B: True, we no fit escape am. My point no be removing interpretation; na letting readers know where e enter. Notes dey do that work.

3123.translation: A: Should delivery-platform workers count as employees? C: Dem choose flexible work time. Employee status go remove flexibility. B: Flexibility matter. But if platform algorithm control work allocation, e fit resemble employer direction. Still, no be every case I call employment. Check control level case by case. C: Wetin about accident protection? B: Apart from deciding employment status, dem fit first provide minimum safety net against work accidents.
